blocks.html: If you’ve been making plans for a long-overdue vacation or a quick getaway in the city, where you’ll stay is just as important as your destination and itinerary. Even more so for the adventurous folks out there who would be inclined to book accommodations that offer flexibility and convenience. After all, who doesn’t want to zone in on having fun and making great memories off the bat, whether by yourself or with your family or friends?

With those things in mind, Robinsons Hotels and Resorts has exciting offerings this 2023 to make your stays as enjoyable and as convenient as they can be, whether it’s in Go Hotels, Summit Hotels, or Grand Summit Hotel.

If you identify as a traveler who gets bouts of wanderlust every now and then, this new service is right up your alley. Standard check-in and check-out times for your accommodations won’t constrain your travel plans anymore, thanks to GO24/7. This new service lets you choose which time to check in, allowing you to have flexible arrivals in order to maximize your itinerary and the day rate you paid for your room. Just make reservations 72 hours prior to your stay and Go Hotels will make sure that your room is ready upon your arrival.

GO24/7 will be initially available in 7 Go Hotels properties, namely Dumaguete, Iloilo, Lanang-Davao, Mandaluyong, Otis-Manila, Puerto Princesa, and Tacloban. One can take advantage of this offer via e-mail bookings, direct calls, and the Go Hotels booking engine. Twenty Robinsons Hotels and Resorts properties are likewise in the pipeline.

For the planners out there who are always on the lookout for bang-for-the-buck deals, GO365 is here! With GO365, you can book your stay in advance—from at least 15 days prior to your chosen dates to a maximum of 365 days on the website—and secure the rate from the day of booking. “This way, you get to avail 10% savings on the best available rate without having to worry about not being able to book rooms and to take advantage of discounts or special offers at the time of booking,” says Joy de Mesa, Robinsons Hotels and Resorts Group Director of Sales and Marketing. This offer will be available across Go Hotels, Go Hotels Plus, Summit Hotels, and Grand Summit. Both GO24/7 and GO365 will be rolled out on 3.2.23 (March 2, 2023).

Completing the new set of services is GO ONLINE, which will make your transactions—whether for online booking and voucher purchase—easier and more convenient. While Robinsons Hotels and Resorts has yet to provide more details about this upcoming service, here’s a hint: You don’t need to do a lot; as they say, “PM is the key.” “All in all, these new services will make booking your stays easier, alongside the convenience of booking that the RHR APP already provides,” de Mesa adds.

Robinsons Hotels and Resorts is the hospitality arm of Robinsons Land Corporation. Under the international deluxe category are IHG-managed Crowne Plaza Galleria and Holiday Inn Galleria, Dusit Thani Mactan Cebu, and upcoming The Westin Manila while homegrown brands include Summit Hotels and Resorts and Go Hotels. The latest addition to the roster is Fili Hotel located at the NUSTAR Resort & Casino, Cebu’s first integrated resort development.
For more information, visit www.robinsonshotels.com or follow Robinsons Hotels and Resorts on Facebook and @robinsonshotelsandresorts on Instagram.
